title: DTCC Launches Tokenization Service on Canton and Private Besu
why_it_matters: The launch moves tokenized securities into a major U.S. depository's operating framework, while access remains permissioned, time-limited and tied to DTC custody.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

DTCC Launches Tokenization Service on Canton and Private Besu

DTC has launched a service for tokenizing eligible custodied securities, with 20 participants signed for access and two private networks supported initially.
